# Security policy

Please report security vulnerabilities in Moss privately by email to [amarantoshelios@outlook.com](mailto:amarantoshelios@outlook.com), not in a public issue or pull request.

Include the affected version or commit, steps to reproduce, and the impact you expect. We will confirm that we received the report, keep you informed while we investigate, and credit you when the fix ships unless you ask us not to. Please give us a reasonable chance to fix the issue before disclosing it publicly.
